project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 80 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 0 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Harlech qualifies as a local detour through Harlech Castle and Castell Harlech. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Harlech: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Harlech offers Harlech Castle, Castell Harlech, Castell Harlech; Harlech Castle within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Harlech Castle
